subject: Investor packet readiness: ARR corridor, bookings recon & commit grooming
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Investor packet readiness: ARR corridor, bookings recon & commit grooming

Team —

We need a tight pass on the investor packet numbers next week. High level asks:

- Final ARR corridor (current vs prior) with reconciled FX and contra items.
- Bookings wash by region and product (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
- Commit gating: list deals we currently show in commit vs at-risk (reason + probability change).

Can each of you own one deliverable and drop a single-sheet artifact into theDrive link below by EOD Monday PDT? I want the board packet to show a clearly auditable trail. Specific owners:

- Laura: ARR corridor reconciliation (covering revenue recognition timing adjustments).
- Marcus: bookings wash + regional split (include last 3 quarters for trend).
- Vanessa: commit gating list + recommended commit lock decisions.
- Marissa: write a 2-paragraph narrative tying the numbers to our ops asks (SLA credits / capacity commitments).
- Neha: run the staged commit QC (incoming vs closed dates) and surface any stage misclassifications.

Deliverable format: one spreadsheet tab per owner, plus a short PDF summary (one page). See draft template attached. If you hit data gaps, flag them explicitly — I prefer transparency over guesswork for the board.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/board-packet-2026-q3
Attachment: 2026_Q3_board_packet_draft_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — I'll consolidate and run a dry run with finance on Thursday.

— Vivek
VP Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Investor packet readiness: ARR corridor, bookings recon & commit grooming

Vivek — quick update and a couple of asks. I dropped the ARR_recon_workbook.csv into the Drive. Notes:

- Reconciled ARR bridge includes three line-items that need ops confirmation: a deferred revenue correction (US region) of -$210k, a customer credit reserve of -$95k, and a currency translation delta of +$120k. The net corridor change is -$185k vs prior.
- I marked the deferred rev correction as "needs evidence" (see sheet column G). Marcus, can you confirm whether any bookings were reclassified between hosted and dedicated in Q2? That impacts the revenue timing call.

I've attached a short one-pager summary (see Drive PDF). If no objections, I'll lock the ARR tab and export for the packet.

Attachment: ARR_recon_workbook.csv (spreadsheet)

— Laura
Head of FP&A
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Investor packet readiness: ARR corridor, bookings recon & commit grooming

Thanks Laura — quick answers and a bookings snapshot.

- No reclassification between hosted and dedicated in Q2 for the accounts in question; the rebooking you flagged was an annual support uplift mis-tagged under professional services. I've corrected that in the bookings worksheet and added a reconciliation column.
- Uploaded booking_stage_report.pdf with the regional splits and week-by-week close velocity for the quarter. Topline: EMEA outperformed NA on average deal size; APAC deals skewed toward private deployments.

Marcus
Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Investor packet readiness: ARR corridor, bookings recon & commit grooming

Looping in my commit grooming output. Key points:

- I created a commit_change_log.txt that lists 12 deals currently in commit bucket with changes this week. Of those, 3 are downgraded to at-risk (2x product fit, 1x pricing approval) and 2 need legal redlines that push expected close dates.
- Recommended action: pull the 3 downgraded deals out of board commit and document rationale; keep the 2 legal redline deals in commit but mark as "legal contingent" and include expected closure window.
- For transparency, I added supporting notes on sales rep commentary and linked the HubSpot records in the Drive.

Attachment: commit_change_log.txt (text)
Related link: HUBSPOT-987654

— Vanessa
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Andrew Molloy <andrew@greystonecap.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2026 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Investor packet readiness: ARR corridor, bookings recon & commit grooming

Vivek / team — appreciated the transparency and the artifacts. A couple of quick asks before the packet goes final:

- Can you produce a one-line audit note for each of the three downgraded deals explaining the trigger and the expected next milestone? We want that in the board packet rather than buried in notes.
- For the deferred revenue correction, can you attach the supporting journal entry (or the ticket number in your ERP) so our finance team can verify?

If you can get those two items into the Drive by COB tomorrow our IR desk will be comfortable flagging the packet as "board-ready."

Thanks — andrew
Andrew Molloy
Principal, Greystone Capital
andrew@greystonecap.com
